class.name: EnetMeshTransport
class.brief_description: Mesh transport for [TickNetwork] over plain ENet connections, for networks between servers.
class.description: Connects the nodes of a mesh directly, without [SceneMultiplayer], which stays free for the star with the clients. Every node has a fixed id and the list of the other nodes; the node with the higher id connects to the lower one and retries while the connection is down. A connection is accepted only from a node in the list, identified by the id it declares when connecting, and only once per id: use it in trusted networks (for example, servers in a LAN), with [member TickNetwork.trust] set to [constant TickNetwork.TRUST_TRUSTED]. It has no DTLS. Between players over the internet, use [EnetHostedMeshTransport]. [codeblock] var mesh := EnetMeshTransport.create(2, 9002) mesh.add_node(1, "10.0.0.1", 9001) mesh.add_node(3, "10.0.0.3", 9003) $Cluster.start(mesh) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_node
method.description: Adds a node of the mesh. This node connects to the nodes with a lower id; the others connect to this one.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates the node [param local_id] (positive), listening on [param port]. The [param compression] mode must be the same on every node. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: get_local_port
method.description: Returns the port this node listens on.

method.name: get_node_simulated_latency
method.description: Returns the simulated latency towards the node [param id] (see [method set_node_simulated_latency]).

method.name: get_nodes
method.description: Returns the ids of the other nodes of the mesh.

method.name: remove_node
method.description: Removes a node from the mesh, closing its connection.

method.name: set_node_simulated_latency
method.description: For debugging: delays what this node sends to the node [param id] by [param seconds] (one way). 0 disables it.

members.member: Seconds without an answer before a node is considered gone; its connection is then closed, and tried again every [member retry_interval]. ENet checks it when it resends, so a node that crashes may take up to about twice this long to be noticed, while a node that closes its connections is noticed at once. A lower value makes a mesh with distributed authority give the roles of a lost node to its successor sooner (see [member TickNetwork.registry_peer]), but drops a node that hangs for that long.
Seconds between connection attempts to a node that isn't connected.

constants.constant: ENet's range coder, suited for small packets. The default.
Zstandard compression; not efficient on packets smaller than 4 KB.
